subject: Request: Early-termination & ramp safeguard approval for HelixTech deal
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Approval needed: HelixTech requests on early-termination & ramp exceptions

Hi Steph,

HelixTech (contact: Lisa Grant) is pushing back on standard ramp & early-termination language in the SOW. They want an opt-out after month 2 of ramp with a 30-day notice, which would let them downscale without penalty. They also asked to remove our ramp minimums for months 3-6.

Why this matters: if we allow opt-out + no ramp minimums we lose material committed spend during the critical first 6 months. This could reduce expected first-year ARR by ~40% on the proposed numbers. Legal instructed me to escalate for exec approval for any deviations from the standard ramp/ET clauses that affect revenue protection.

Attached: HelixTech_SOW_v2_redline.pdf and a proposed ramp_schedule_proposal.xlsx with their asks highlighted.

Proposed alternatives from my side (ranked):
- Option A (preferred): Allow opt-out after month 2 only if customer agrees to a downsell protection that recoups 60% of expected revenue for remaining ramp months (via a one-time make-whole charge).
- Option B: Keep standard ramp minimums but allow a 30-day opt-out with a prorated termination fee equal to 2 months' minimum spend.
- Option C: No opt-out; propose adding extra observability + a 1:1 success plan to reduce churn risk.

Need: Exec sign-off on which option we can offer by EOD Friday (2026-06-04) so we can feed to procurement.

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval needed: HelixTech requests on early-termination & ramp exceptions

Rishi — thanks for the summary and the files.

Looping in Marissa for executive approval and Olga from legal for a quick read on the language. Karthik — any product / SLA constraints we should call out before Marissa decides?

I think Option A gives us the most protection while giving the customer flexibility. If we approve, legal will need explicit redline text for the make-whole calculation.

Steph

On Jun 1, 2026, at 09:12, Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> Hi Steph,
> 
> HelixTech (contact: Lisa Grant) is pushing back on standard ramp & early-termination language...
> (see attachments)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval needed: HelixTech requests on early-termination & ramp exceptions

Quick product note: we can instrument a stepped ramp that enforces minimums at the platform layer for months 1-3 and then relaxes; metrics for utilization and token volume are easy to capture for the make-whole calc.

If Legal wants a deterministic formula for the make-whole, I recommend: make-whole = max(0, expected_revenue_remaining * 0.6 - actual_revenue_received). We can also support a 30-day notice process in the console to trigger billing changes.

Happy to scope the telemetry change if we sign off on Option A.

Karthik

On Jun 1, 2026, at 10:03, Stephanie Nguyen wrote:
> Rishi — thanks for the summary...
From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@helixtech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: HelixTech Procurement <procurement@helixtech.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelixTech SOW redline (clarifying ramp/termination ask)

Stephanie / Rishi — thanks for the quick responses. A few clarifications from our side so the legal folks can move fast:

1) We are asking for the ability to opt-out after month 2 of the initial ramp with 30 days' notice. Our rationale: our usage projections depend on three product features that are still in pilot; if pilots fail we need a short escape.
2) We are open to a reasonable revenue protection mechanism; our procurement team prefers capped fees vs open-ended make-wholes. A capped make-whole (equal to 25% of expected remaining ramp commitment) would be acceptable to us.
3) We need the ramp minimums removed for months 3-6, because our internal rollout could be delayed.

We'd like to close this week. I've attached a redline back with our proposed cap.

Best,
Lisa

--
Lisa Grant
Senior Director, Cloud Partnerships | HelixTech
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelixTech SOW redline (clarifying ramp/termination ask)

Heads up from CS: HelixTech's pilot feature risk is real, but if we remove ramp minimums entirely we reduce CS's ability to resource a success manager and pro-actively manage onboarding. If we land on a capped make-whole we should require a shared success plan and at least one executive sponsorship meeting in month 1.

Suggested operational guardrails if we allow opt-out:
- Require a 90-day minimum billing obligation overall (even if they can downscale usage — we collect payment for 90 days)
- Mandatory onboarding milestones in month 1 documented in the SOW
- Cap on make-whole equal to 25% of remaining ramp commitment (per customer ask) but only if customer completes milestone checklist in month 1

Monica
Customer Success Manager
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Approval needed: HelixTech requests on early-termination & ramp exceptions

Team — after reviewing the trade-offs and HelixTech's counter, I approve a constrained deviation from standard terms with the following conditions (executive approval):

1) Allow one opt-out after month 2 with 30 days' notice.
2) Require a 90-day minimum billing obligation starting on contract effective date (this preserves baseline revenue).
3) Implement a capped make-whole equal to 25% of the expected remaining ramp commitment (this matches customer ask).
4) Require documented onboarding milestones in month 1 (CS to own) and at least one executive sponsorship touch.
5) Legal (Olga) to produce explicit redline text for the SOW: make-whole formula, notice process, and confirmation that make-whole is the exclusive remedy for early termination during ramp.

Conditions are binding for this approval: if procurement pushes for anything broader (multiple opt-outs, uncapped make-whole, or removal of the 90-day minimum), the ask must be escalated to the VP Sales.

Marissa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@helixtech.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Approved deviation — next steps and docs

Lisa — thank you and appreciate the flexibility. Per Marissa's approval above, we can accept the single opt-out after month 2 with 30 days' notice under the following binding terms: 90-day minimum billing obligation, capped make-whole = 25% of remaining ramp commitment, and required onboarding milestones documented in the SOW.

Next steps:
- Olga will circulate a redlined SOW with the exact make-whole clause and termination notice language by EOD tomorrow.
- Rishi / Monica will update the ramp schedule and add the milestone checklist to the SOW (I've attached a first draft).
- Lisa / Procurement: please confirm acceptance of the capped make-whole and 90-day minimum once you review Olga's redline.

Attachments: HelixTech_SOW_v2_redline.pdf, ramp_schedule_proposal.xlsx
DocuSign link (wip): https://app.docusign.com/HelixTech/HT-1123

Steph
Account Director | Redwood Inference
